## FLOOWBOX - Media Sentiment Tracker
Runs every Friday at 4 PM.
3 parallel Perplexity searches:
- Tech media sentiment (TechCrunch, Wired, Verge)
- Business media sentiment (Bloomberg, Forbes, WSJ)
- Social signals (Twitter, LinkedIn, HN, Reddit)
GPT-4o synthesizes week's sentiment + tracks week-over-week.
Logs trend to Google Sheets for historical comparison.
Friday Slack report for the week.
